title: Attribution Completion
description: attribution-completion/v1: the document an attribution-completed event carries. The pledger reports how the plan behind one posting ended. The event cites the posting; the report id and the plan id are repeated so a reader can join it without the posting.

reportId.description: The margin call the posting answers, repeated from the posting so a reader can group the completion with it.

status.description: How the plan ended. A failed movement delivered nothing and is posted again.

reason.description: Why the plan failed, as the router reported it.
